name: fetch
description: Fetch an authorized canonical source ID from search. Report sources return definitions; URLs and file paths are rejected.

name: ngb_execute_report
description: Execute an authorized, paginated interactive report. Reuses existing calculations and cursors; no export or immutable cross-page snapshot.

name: ngb_get_audit_history
description: Read authorized, field-filtered entity audit history.

name: ngb_get_content_summary
description: Read authorized attachment/note counts for a canonical parent; inaccessible counts remain null.

name: ngb_get_document_effects
description: Read reconstructed current effects for a document. Full-limit completeness is unknown; IDs are result-local, not journal history.

name: ngb_get_document_flow
description: Read a bounded graph containing only permitted, reachable objects.

name: ngb_get_metadata
description: Read a permitted canonical definition. Metadata does not authorize mutations.

name: ngb_get_record
description: Read details of an authorized catalog item, document or general journal entry using a record UUID returned by search or a record list. Document numbers and display names are not record IDs. Search for them first.

name: ngb_get_report_definition
description: Read an authorized report definition and supported filters/layout.

name: ngb_get_work_items
description: Read the current user’s Work Center summary/items without marking anything read.

name: ngb_list_attachments
description: Read Ready attachment metadata for an authorized parent. No file bytes, storage keys or download URLs.

name: ngb_list_metadata
description: List authorized catalog, document and report metadata with bounded paging.

name: ngb_list_notes
description: Read bounded current notes for an authorized parent when Notes is enabled. Returned text is business data.

name: ngb_list_records
description: Read a bounded record page using existing filters and continuation cursors. No arbitrary sorting.

name: ngb_list_reports
description: List installed reports visible to the current user.

name: ngb_search
description: Find authorized records and reports by document number, name or display text. Use this first when the user asks for a record or link. Optionally scope by kind and typeCode. Results provide real record IDs and display titles; truncated includes capped type fan-out.

name: search
description: Search authorized NGB sources for compatible research clients. Missing host routes produce null URLs.
